title: Sign and coordinate face parametrization
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. Every sign vector in ${-1,1}^n$ is uniquely specified by its sign at coordinate $i$ together with a sign vector whose $i$th coordinate is $1$; equivalently, the product of the two element sign set and the dimension edge at $i$ is in bijection with ${-1,1}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
